sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To express possession, Hungarian commonly uses a possessed noun with a dative possessor and van/vannak.

You can front the dative pronoun for emphasis — nekem van egy autóm stresses 'I'm the one who has a car' — or drop it entirely when it's obvious from context, as in plain van egy autóm. Both are correct; the difference is emphasis, not grammar.
